question: Which of the following does NOT impact a computer's general performance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Size of the Graphics Card.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The speed of the CPU** and the ability of the CPU to run multiple processes.
 
• The speed of the CPU is a direct measurement of how many instructions it can complete per second.
 
• Processor performance can be affected by clock speed, cache size, and the number of cores the processor has.
 
• **Increasing **processor speed is the most, it will definitely improve computer's performance as this is where computer performance depends.
 
• The memory capacity of most modern graphics cards ranges from **2 GB to 24 GB.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **7 Ways to Improve Your Computer Performance**

 
 
• Uninstall unnecessary software.
 
• Limit the programs at the startup. 
 
• Add more RAM to your PC.
 
• Check for spyware and viruses.
 
• Use Disk Cleanup and defragmentation.
 
• Consider a startup SSD.
 
• Take a look at your web browser.
 
 
 
• **Factors that affect performance in the operating system**
 
 
• NUMBER OF CORES (PROCESSORS) 
 
• MULTIPLE APPLICATIONS AFFECTING COMPUTER SPEED.
 
• GRAPHICS CARD TYPE.
 
• DATA BUS WIDTH. 
 
• MEMORY CACHE.
 
 
 
• **Hard Disc Speed**
 
 
• HDDs can copy 30 to 150 MB per second (MB/s), while standard SSDs perform the same action at speeds of 500 MB/s.
 
 
 
• **RAM Size**
 
 
• RAM comes shaped in physical strips. Each strip has a set amount of memory storage space ranging from 2GB to 32GB.
 
 
 
• **CPU Speed**
 
 
• A good processor speed is between 3.50 to 4.2 GHz, but it is more important to have a single-thread performance.
